adjudication.rationale: The diff shows duplicated DB-fetch-and-reshape logic in `packages/core/EventManager.ts` in both `createAllCalendarEvents` and `updateAllCalendarEvents`: each does `prisma.credential.findUnique({ include: { app: { select: { slug: true }}} ... })` and then conditionally reshapes only if `credentialFromDB && credentialFromDB.app?.slug`, otherwise leaving `credential` undefined and skipping event creation/update. A third similar-but-not-identical credential-fetch path exists in `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts` (fetches credential from DB if not found in user credentials). This is a concrete maintainability/edge-case risk introduced/expanded by the PR (logic can drift; missing `app.slug` causes silent skip), but it’s not itself a directly provable runtime defect from the diff alone.
